title: Complete two-pivot caller readers and certify fixed-chart retiming costs
body:
The source-handoff prefix's apparent saving disappears when both dirty pivots and every original-input reader are completed. This supplies the complete all-q caller: for n=2q+2, its histogram is H_(2f)=n²+2 and H_(4f)=1, giving full stock plus 8f.

An exact certificate of 36 edge-disjoint odd Eulerian subgraphs proves the six-bank fixed native-product chart compiler cannot beat stock 72f. The physical-word-to-graph implication is proved for every chart choice; the matching six-bank and eight-bank break-even words are replayed. Separate complete triangular/balanced eight-bank words improve rank mass 138f to saved quadratic choices of 130f against stock 128f. Their actual source circuits, global phases, all original columns and both inverse orders are checked. No optimizer bound is trusted.

The fixed-compiler floor does not cover changed callers or new charts. Retimed ranks still need literal selected-native lowerings and complete recursive/physical admission. No new κ, selected-frontier change, compatible BIT supplier, ownership/precision/tape admission or formal-kernel theorem is claimed.

Only `research/two-pivot-caller-readers/` is added. Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-pivot-caller-readers
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/two-pivot-caller-readers --check-source-history
```

At exact head `896e2a2e89fd2b54d4defafaef3b91bb4b33b493-standalone`, registered normal/optimized replay, committed raw-byte/source-history checks and official export/integrity pass. The read-only Git-free export also passes normal/optimized isolated Python with empty PATH and unchanged source bytes/modes/inodes. Export SHA256: `d678daaac4f8fd79cf09a684a32c4f5d1eaed6765204253b7363bfb4be301049`. Hosted CI is reported separately. A separate Codex review checked the proofs and unchanged mathematical bytes plus the final attribution/license delta; no independent human or kernel acceptance is claimed.

Already-published #3630/#3632/#3645/#3649/#3655 and separate BIT #4021/#4023 are excluded.
